Replication, Consensus & Coordination

How a group of computers that can crash, pause and lose messages still agrees on one truth: who the leader is, what the log says, who holds the lock, and which write came first.

sections.before:
Level 3 - Intermediate

You might confuse this with... a quorum (R + W > N) and consensus (Raft, Paxos) both talk about "a majority", but they promise different things. A quorum only guarantees that a read set overlaps the latest write set, so you can find the newest version; it does not order concurrent writes, and two clients can still disagree. Consensus makes all nodes agree on one order of operations, through a single leader per term, so it gives linearizable results. Dynamo and Cassandra use quorums; etcd, ZooKeeper and KRaft use consensus.
